turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Could you tell me what brought you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sure, you know I've been having this chest pain for the since last night. Um, and I'm also having a hard time breathing so thought I should check it out.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, um and so the chest pain came on last night. Were you doing anything before before it coming on?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I was just about to head to bed and suddenly I felt this crampy pain in my chest.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and where is this pain located?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'd say like the center of my chest.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, uh, has the pain been going on constantly since last night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I would say so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, has it changed in character at all? You said it was crampy, but has it felt like anything else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no. Just just crampy, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, did you feel the pain anywhere else, or do you feel it just in the center of your chest?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah yes, center of my chest going up to around my throat area maybe.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see and anything that you've done, that's made the pain worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I guess taking in a deep breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and how about changing positions, does the pain get worse if you lie flat or or if you lean forward?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, um, and have you ever had a pain like this in your chest before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and and has the pain get been getting worse, getting better, staying the same?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's been the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, have you taken anything for it, to help with the pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and the shortness of breath you mentioned, uh, when did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Around the same time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok and, is this trouble breathing like after walking a certain distance or exerting yourself?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it it it, it's just always there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and have you noticed any changes to the sounds of your breathing, like a wheeze or whistling sound?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, maybe maybe a slight wheeze.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, do you think that you're breathing more quickly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok um, have you had a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No cough, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and so you haven't been bringing up any sputum or or any blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok and, have you had a sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No sore throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, so you've had this chest pain since last night and shortness of breath that started around a similar time last night. Have you had any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just just some fatigue, some tiredness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and did that start around the same time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That started a few days before, like maybe two days before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, has there been any change to your sleep or any stressful events happen that might be tiring you out?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and have you had any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, no headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about any eye symptoms like discharge or or eye pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any any redness of your eye?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, so have you had a runny nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and uh have you felt like your heart is racing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, have you had a loss of taste or smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you had a decrease in your appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, ok and have you had any changes to your weight in the last several months?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright and, have you had any diarrhea or constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and how about any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, none.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any abdominal pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and how about any confusion or or concerns around memory?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and, any muscle aches or pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Maybe slight muscle aches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any weakness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and any rashes you noticed anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No none.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and have you had a fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about any any chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No chills.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright and then any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and do you have any medical conditions that you see a physician regularly for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, actually sorry, I have diabetes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, is that type 2?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Type 2.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and are you taking any medications for that or is it kind of diet or lifestyle controlled?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm on insulin for that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and you use a sliding scale or do you have a regimen you use?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I have, so I have like a long acting and short acting, so I just take the long acting before I go to bed and then the short acting before meals.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see ok. So that sounds like a great, a great plan. Do you take any other medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I take some vitamins and you know, like vitamin D and calcium, but that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm allergic to penicillin.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, have you had antibiotics recently for any reason?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and are your immunizations up to date?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think so. I think the only thing is I have to see if I'm up to date with my Pneumovax.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, great yeah I was wondering about that one so we can look into that certainly. And do you know if you've had the Zoster or the Shingles vaccine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I had that one.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok great um, and um next could you I was wondering if you could tell me a little bit about your living situation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sure, I live with my husband. We live in a 3 bedroom townhouse. It's a fairly new home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, great. Did you recently move there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes we did.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, cool. And so there's no concerns with like old carpets or being exposed to kind of like dust or or molds or anything like that in the home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and um, has your husband been sick at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, he's been fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and do you have any pets in the home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: We have a cat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you have any allergies to pets?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, um and how do you support yourself financially right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, we're both retired, but we have our RESP savings.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh excellent, ok, and for your previous occupation, were you exposed to any chemicals or like asbestos or inhalants that you're aware of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have maybe a glass or two glasses of wine over the weekends.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, and do you smoke marijuana or use any cannabis products?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about the use of any other recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok and, and has anybody in your family had a heart condition before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: My mother passed away when she was 80, she had some valvular issues.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok um, uh, ok, and has anybody in the family had a heart attack before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and, anybody have any lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and then any cancer that runs in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Cancer? No no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok um, I think that's all I wanted to cover on the the history today. Was there anything else you'd like to tell me that I was, that I maybe didn't ask about?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I think you asked me all those other questions, I'm just wondering what do you like, what do you think I have?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, certainly, uh, so it could possibly be something related to the heart. I don't, and sometimes especially people in your age group who have diabetes can have chest pain and symptoms that could be nonspecific. And so we will, we will check that for sure. We'll get an ECG and some lab work with the troponin and also a chest X Ray so that we can investigate for that. And also the chest X Ray could help us look to see if you have something going on in your lungs, like a possible pneumonia or, maybe a viral infection as well, which could include something like COVID-19. So we'll be ordering a PCR nasal swab as well to test for that. And so in the meantime, because we'll be doing that test, it requires self quarantine for 14 days so, if possible, that would mean distancing from your husband in the home as well for that 14 day period, but the results should come back from that test within the next several days. And and sorry, also if it is positive, we will have to notify public health as well so that the appropriate contact tracing can be done.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ok, ok well thank you very much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Now you're very welcome. We'll get the investigations started now.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sure, sounds good.
